proposals.synthetic_case_summary: R1-1 4-unit multiplex, no overlay, front setback conforming, parking short by 2, two Stage 1 docs missing. Gold: as-of-right-ssmuh.
proposals.rationale: Addresses triage error class wrong_pathway_label_aor_predicted_as_discretionary. Shows the model that a parking deficit and missing docs are completeness gaps, not pathway triggers.

proposals.synthetic_case_summary: R1-1 3-unit multiplex, no overlay, FSR 1.04 vs 1.0 limit, one missing Stage 1 doc. Gold: as-of-right-ssmuh.
proposals.rationale: Addresses triage error class wrong_pathway_label_aor_predicted_as_discretionary. Shows the model that a minor FSR numeric gap does not upgrade the pathway to discretionary.

proposals.synthetic_case_summary: R1-1 4-unit multiplex, no overlay, all numerics conforming, two Stage 1 docs missing. Gold: as-of-right-ssmuh.
proposals.rationale: Addresses triage error class wrong_pathway_label_aor_predicted_as_discretionary. Reinforces that missing documents alone do not trigger discretionary routing.

proposals.synthetic_case_summary: R1-1 4-unit multiplex, no overlay, front setback 5.1 m vs 6.0 m ZDB-R1-1-FRONT-SETBACK minimum. Gold: discretionary.
proposals.rationale: Addresses triage error class wrong_pathway_label_discretionary_predicted_as_aor. Shows the model that a front-setback non-conformance is a policy trigger for discretionary routing.

proposals.synthetic_case_summary: R1-1 4-unit multiplex, no overlay, front setback 4.8 m vs 6.0 m minimum, two Stage 1 docs missing. Gold: discretionary.
proposals.rationale: Addresses triage error class wrong_pathway_label_discretionary_predicted_as_aor. Confirms that front-setback non-conformance drives the discretionary outcome even when completeness gaps are also present.

rationale: Triage found 6 cases where the model confused completeness and numeric gaps with discretionary routing triggers, and 2 cases where it missed ZDB-R1-1-FRONT-SETBACK non-conformance as the discretionary signal. Three new as-of-right examples with missing docs or numeric gaps teach the distinction. Two new discretionary examples with front-setback shortfalls teach the policy trigger.
